title: Ops embedded partnership playbook + retro notes (90d pilot)
body:
Overview:
This is the working playbook + retro notes for the "ops-embedded partnership" 90-day pilot aimed at improving SLO adoption, operational handoffs, and cross-functional ownership at the feature-team level. The doc is intentionally rough — minutes, experiment logs, and decisions all in one place.

Background:
- Problem: feature teams ship model-serving features without consistent SLOs or runbook contracts. Oncall and SRE end up firefighting without clear remediation steps.
- Hypothesis: embedding a rotating ops liaison into feature teams for 90 days (paired with a compact SLO template and sprint checklist) will increase SLO coverage, reduce mean time to mitigation (MTTM), and reduce pages for repeatable issues.

High-level objectives (success metrics):
- Coverage: 60% of targeted feature teams have a documented SLO + basic runbook by day 60.
- Signal quality: baseline alerts reduced by 25% (noise -> fewer false-positive pages).
- Time to mitigation: median MTTM for pilot teams reduced by 30% within 90 days.
- Oncall load: reduce repeated wakeups for the same underlying issue by 40% for pilot services.

Scope and exclusions:
- In scope: model-serving endpoints (hosted API + dedicated), latency and error-rate SLOs, runbook templates, alert tuning, and pair-oncall experiments.
- Out of scope: infra-level capacity planning (handled by platform-engineering), customer SLA negotiation.

Stakeholders & roles: (quick reference)
- Pilot lead / owner: Aisha Patel (SRE lead)
- Product sponsor: Luis Ortega (Product - hosted api)
- Embedded ops liaisons: rotating SREs (Daniel, Maya, Tomoko as first rotation)
- Feature-team leads: 4 product/eng squads participating (names in linked doc)
- Observability support: Observability team (console-and-tooling) — contact: Priya Rao

SLO template (compact):
- Service: <service-name>
- User-facing objective: e.g., "99th percentile tail latency < 400ms for text-generation endpoint"
- Measurement window: 7d rolling
- Error budget policy: throttle + notify when 30% budget used, stakeholder escalations at 60% and 90%
- Runbook quick links: top-3 diagnostics, fallback model variant, canary flag, rollback link

Pilot design & experiments (lab style):
- Experiment A: Pair oncall shadowing — embedded SRE sits in feature-team standup and triages first week incidents together. 
  - Metrics: number of distinct root causes identified; time for knowledge transfer (measured by checklist signoffs).
- Experiment B: Alert pruning sprint — reduce alerts by consolidating duplicate detectors and turning on dynamic thresholds.
  - Target: 30% fewer unique alert IDs for pilot services.
- Experiment C: Rapid rollback & fallback drills — practice switching to a lighter-weight model variant under load.
  - Acceptance: failover completes within SLA window in >=80% of drills.

90-day milestone map (brief):
- Day 0-14: Kickoff, align owners, instrument SLI baselines, create SLO drafts.
- Day 15-30: First rotation embedding, run alert pruning sprint, draft runbooks.
- Day 31-60: Iterate SLOs with product leads, run two rollback drills, finalize runbooks for 60% coverage.
- Day 61-90: Harden alert policies, measure MTTM, capture learnings, prepare runbook for wider rollouts + exec brief.

Weekly cadence (recommended):
- Mon: sync 30m with product sponsor + liaison pair (status: SLO coverage, blockers).
- Wed: 60m ops workshop (alert pruning triage + runbook review).
- Fri: async retro notes in this doc; short show-and-tell of any drills.

Practical checklist for embedded week (template for liaisons):
- Join standup, ask: "where is the SLO for this piece?"
- Run SLI collection query and save baseline in shared spreadsheet
- Validate existing alerts (are they actionable?)
- Walk through top-3 recent incidents with feature team
- Add two runbook steps for quick mitigation and one for escalation
- Add a doc link in feature repo + Slack shortcuts

Runbook minimum (for each pilot service):
1) Symptoms -> immediate triage steps (3 bullets)
2) Quick mitigation (disable canary / switch model / scale pool)
3) Owner & escalation path (oncall, product, SRE liaison)
4) Postmortem triggers (when to run full postmortem)

Risk register (selected items):
- Risk: Feature teams view liaison as extra baggage -> mitigation: surface wins early (reduced pages metric)
- Risk: Observability gaps -> mitigation: add temporary dashboards + guardrails before embedding
- Risk: SLAs vs SLO diff -> mitigation: product sponsor clarifies customer-impacted lanes up front

Retro notes & early observations (raw):
- Week 1: embedding useful for context; main blocker was missing SLI instrumentation for model queue times. Action: infra track INF-4912 created by Daniel.
- Week 3: alert pruning discovered 2 duplicate thresholds firing during scale tests. We merged detectors and reduced noise.
- Week 5: one drill failed because fallback variant lacked warm cache; added cache-warm step to runbook.
- Anecdote: feature lead appreciated a short 1-page SLO that was phrased in customer terms. Keep wording customer-centric.

Decisions made so far: (short log)
- Adopt compact SLO template above as canonical for pilot (Aisha, Luis, 2025-11-20).
- Rolling 2-week liaison rotation model accepted (decision 2025-11-28).
- Use 7d rolling window for latency SLOs to match telemetry retention (decision 2025-12-04).

Open questions (needs ownership):
- Q1: How do we migrate pilot SLOs into the global SLO registry? Owner: Priya Rao (observability).
- Q2: When to declare a pilot service "ready" for platform handoff? Proposed: 60% runbook coverage + two successful drills. Owner: Aisha.
- Q3: Are we aligning error budget policies with sales/legal for enterprise customers? Owner: Luis (product).

Next steps (immediate action items):
- A1: Daniel to open the instrumentation PR for model-queue SLIs (jira:INF-4920) — due 2025-11-18.
- A2: Maya to run alert-pruning sprint and produce a before/after noise dashboard — due 2025-11-30.
- A3: Tomoko to schedule 2 rollback drills with feature teams in week of 2025-12-08.
- A4: Aisha to compile interim metrics and do a 30-day readout for execs — due 2025-12-15.

Post-pilot artifacts to produce:
- 1-page playbook for embedding (public to SRE + platform)
- Migration guide: pilot -> platform handoff checklist
- Template SLO + runbook generator (initial script in github PR linked above)
- Executive brief with measured impact (pages avoided, MTTM reduction)

Notes to future readers:
- This doc is intentionally a mix of planning + raw retro. When copying into a canonical playbook, reorganize into playbook (stable) and lab journal (ephemeral).
- Tag any followups with jira INF-49xx.

Contact & context:
- Slack: @aisha.patel (ops), channel #reliability-embedded, calendar: Ops Embedded Pilot (weekly sync invite).

Appendix: quick links (copied because I keep losing them)
- Instrumentation spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1-example (internal)
- Pilot backlog slice: https://jira.company/browse/INF-4912; https://jira.company/browse/INF-4920
- Draft confluence brief: confluence:INF-ops-embedded-brief

Raw meeting notes (cut-and-paste fragments):
- 2025-11-12 kickoff: "we need something that product teams actually read" — Luis. Action: shorten SLO template to customer phrases.
- 2025-11-19 ops workshop: discovered metric gaps, agreed to a lightweight SLI export script.

End of doc.

(If you're reading this and want to join the next rotation, ping me on Slack and I'll schedule a short sync.)
